The 'Begin Summoning' button at the very bottom is cut off and lacks a clear visual link to the 'Summon' card above it, making the primary call-to-action ambiguous. Re-center the hero orb: Position the orb in the center of the screen or directly behind the title to create a unified atmospheric background rather than a side element. 3. Unify the menu: Move the 'Choose Your Path' cards to a centered, full-width grid below the hero area to create a clear top-to-bottom reading flow (Brand -> Atmosphere -> Action). 4. Ensure the bottom CTA buttons have at least 40px of bottom padding to prevent clipping. 2. **Standardize Card Grid:** Enforce a strict 2x2 grid with equal height cards. Align all icons to the top-left corner with a fixed 24px margin.
